Off-file census and S5 comparison support all classes: sole C_API spec/body, S5's On component files, and protected-only Off files. These are existing open body obligations, not authorized exemptions.
Pure insertion diffs, anchors, specs and External_Name counts match. Old child block cannot be carried verbatim into C-API v4's exact runs/residual.
All named renamings are within package body Child_Boundary. They are not C_API body-level declarations. Rebase scope-merging remains a hazard; no current same-scope collision is asserted.

All listed same-thread re-acquisitions are supported at their receivers; service and principal share the exact Gate by constructor identity. Base/service files are byte-identical to A1-selected origins. Not reproduced; other paths and cross-thread lock freedom remain open.
append serializes BEGIN IMMEDIATE and derives previous head itself; signature has no expected head/phase/generation and native Legal is absent.
capture_execution appends ACTOR_EXECUTION_NATIVE inside an ACK; _current calls it. The seed-before-second-capture order supports a conditional stale-seed risk once earlier blockers are repaired.

Child block counts match 84 non-attribute Size tokens and 67 Size attributes. Same-spelled literals versus spec subtype are real textual declarations; installed overload/hiding/warning behavior is unmeasured. Rename/move rule is conservative and sound.

Root namespace/image/challenge and child image/challenge pairs are filled from the same values at the cited producers; peer pairs use distinct sources. Only these native equalities are vacuous; other classification predicates and separate producer checks remain real.
